source: Create a 3D fps shooter enclosed inside a huge hollow square outer wall structure, with 3d guns without being blocky, add A Assult rifle, a pistol, a sniper, a smg, a shotgun, knife, grenade and make it that i can equip the guns in a gun slot like rivals and also with the matchmaking intermission 30 seconds long and the in game match length to be 7 miniutes long with game modes like free for all, teamdeath match and capture the flag

image_prompt.text: Flag stands at each team's end, scored by carrying the enemy flag back
Interior routes letting fast players bypass the main-lane standoff
Balanced team bases at opposite ends, shielded from enemy sniper lines
A huge hollow square outer wall enclosing the entire playable area

layout_placement.text: Flag stands scored by carrying the flag to them
Opposing team spawns at opposite ends of the square

notes: One map has to serve free-for-all, team deathmatch and capture the flag; team-base spawns and flag stands are needed for CTF but must not break free-for-all.
The square outer wall is a fixed map boundary. The only boundary option available is the contracting one, which is not what was asked, so the wall is carried as free text in the image stream.
Weapon list, gun-slot equipping, 30-second intermission and 7-minute match length are all outside the layout job and are recorded as gaps.

open_questions.ask: No theme was stated - should the arena inside the square read as military, industrial, or something else?
How wide is the square - a tight arena or a large open field?

coverage_missing.ask: No theme was stated - should the arena inside the square read as military, industrial, or something else?
How wide is the square wall enclosure?
Should the weapons also appear as pickups in the map, or only in the loadout slots?

answers.ask: No theme was stated - should the arena inside the square read as military, industrial, or something else?
answers.answer: Make the arena military-themed, fitting the FPS weapons and game modes.

answers.ask: How wide is the square - a tight arena or a large open field?
answers.answer: Use a tight, compact arena inside the huge hollow square walls so matches stay fast and playable.
